summary.key_finding: Estácio degree strongly covers BAS core IT/management requirements. Computer Networks, Security Management, Project Management, Database, and IT Governance courses map directly to Broward BAS technical courses.
summary.caveat: Final determination requires Broward advisor review and WES Course-by-Course evaluation. Mapping is estimated based on course content alignment.

mappings.match_rationale: TCP/IP, routing protocols, network topologies — core CCNA2 content. Combined with CCNA cert this strongly supports the mapping.
Security management, risk, compliance — overlaps directly with Security+ domains. Combined with Security+ cert CPL.
IT project management methodologies, PMBoK framework — direct match. Google PM cert + this WES course = strong CPL case.
Advanced PM application — Estácio PM course + Google PM + PMI certs build a compelling PLA portfolio.
mappings.elimination_path: PLA portfolio (Google PM + PMI + Estácio course + 20 yrs experience)

mappings.match_rationale: Database design, SQL, data management — partial overlap with DataSys+ domains. CompTIA DataSys+ cert would fully cover this.
mappings.elimination_path: CompTIA DataSys+ CPL (future) + WES database course as supporting evidence

mappings.match_rationale: BI, dashboards, data visualization — maps well to Data Analytics elective content.
IT governance frameworks (COBIT, ISO 27001), policy management — strong match to ISM course content.
Systems audit includes vulnerability assessment and compliance — supporting context for ethical hacking but not a direct replacement. Use as PLA supporting evidence.
ITIL service management — directly aligns with IT systems management course.

mappings.estacio_name: DELIVERY AND SUPPORT IN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
mappings.match_rationale: IT delivery/support overlaps with web systems topics but is not a direct match. Useful as supplementary transfer evidence.
Computer organization/architecture is foundational science. May partially satisfy a GE natural science slot.
mappings.elimination_path: Advisor review — may transfer as technical elective

mappings.match_rationale: Organizational psychology shares core foundations with general psychology GE requirement.
mappings.elimination_path: WES transfer — advisor may accept for GE Social Sciences

mappings.match_rationale: IP law and ethics has humanities/philosophy crossover. May satisfy one humanities GE slot.
mappings.elimination_path: Advisor review for GE Humanities credit

area1_communication.recommended_path: Sophia Learning (English Comp I & II, Public Speaking) — ~$99-198

area2_humanities.covered_by_estacio: Partial — CCT0752 (Law & Ethics) may cover 1 slot

area3_social_sciences.recommended_path: CLEP American Government ($93) + WES for 1 slot
